title: Canonical structured evidence for specialized Hostinger guards

phases.objective: Add a trusted exact-head publisher route for the companion Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Canonical Evidence workflow without changing the existing general CI publisher or granting repository/runtime mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository reviewer and trusted workflow_run publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A completed Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Canonical Evidence run carrying a canonical structured artifact for the logical Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The trusted main-based publisher validates the exact PR head, source workflow, logical guard, contract, counts, no-secret declaration, and no-log decision before updating the shared authoritative PR comment.
steps: Receive a completed workflow_run event only for Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Canonical Evidence.
Checkout trusted main without persisted credentials.
Download only the run-bound hostinger-storage-tenant-canary summary artifact.
Validate that the report logical workflow is Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard while the source workflow is the companion canonical-evidence workflow.
Validate guard identity, contract, candidate kind, exact candidate SHA, check counts, result count, first failure, secrets declaration, and job_logs_consulted=false.
Resolve exactly one open or merged PR from event PR number or exact repository, branch, and head SHA.
Reject stale, substituted, ambiguous, or closed-unmerged PR identities.
Add or replace only the Hostinger Tenant Canary section inside the existing mad4b canonical evidence comment.
assertions: The source workflow is Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Canonical Evidence.
The report logical guard is Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard and guard_key is hostinger-storage-tenant-canary.
The candidate kind is head and candidate SHA equals workflow_run.head_sha.
Passed evidence requires all selected checks to pass, zero integrity findings, and first_failure=null.
Failed evidence identifies the first failed check and cannot be published by a successful workflow conclusion.
The report declares secrets_included=false and job_logs_consulted=false.
The publisher runs from trusted main with actions:read, issues:write, pull-requests:write, contents:read, and persist-credentials:false.
The specialized publisher shares the existing authoritative comment marker rather than creating a competing status surface.
Neither the existing Tenant Canary Guard nor the companion PR-head workflow receives comment-write authority.
No deployment, provider call, credential access, migration, SQL, external send, Production mutation, protected-branch mutation, or force push occurs.

phases.objective: Observe the first real companion Tenant Canary canonical artifact after the producer child PR is integrated and verify trusted comment publication on the exact head.

Exercise artifact absence, malformed JSON, stale SHA, source/logical workflow mismatch, conflicting counts, ambiguous PR resolution, cancelled workflow runs, and publisher retries while keeping Job logs diagnostic-only.
Extend the same bounded contract to Shared Canary and Production Preflight only after Tenant Canary publication is proven end to end.
This repository evidence publisher grants no runtime, Hostinger, deployment, migration, or Production authority.
